items.title: 15.5 Young ka double slit tajurba (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Young's double-slit experiment (PDF 50-53).

blocks.text: 1801 mein Thomas Young ne yeh tajurba roshni ki lehar wali fitrat dikhane ke liye kiya. Roshni ki shua shua ke amudan do mutawazi slits par parti hai. Roshni har slit se diffract ho kar bahar phailti hai, aur dono slits ki roshni screen par mil kar roshan aur andhere patton ka interference naqsha banati hai jinhein fringes kehte hain. Dono sources coherent hone chahiye, constant phase farq aur aik wavelength ke saath; aaj yeh aik laser shua ko do slits se guzar kar aasani se hota hai (Fig 15.8).

items: Nuqta A, slits ke darmiyani nuqte ke bilkul samne: dono shuaein barabar faasla tay karti hain, is liye rasta farq sifar. In phase nikal kar in phase pohanchti aur constructive interference karti hain: roshan fringe.

Nuqta B, pehle andhere fringe ka darmiyan: slit 1 ki roshni thora zyada faasla tay karti, aur rasta farq aadhi wavelength. Shuaein ulte phase (180 darje) mein pohanch kar destructive interference karti hain.
Nuqta C, agle roshan fringe ka darmiyan: rasta farq poori wavelength, is liye shuaein in phase pohanch kar constructive interference karti hain.

blocks.title: Fig 15.9 ke captions
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig 15.9 ke captions panel (b) ko pehla roshan ilaqa aur panel (c) ko pehla andhera ilaqa kehte hain, lekin khaake ulat dikhate hain: (b) mein aadhi wavelength ka izafi faasla (andhera) aur (c) mein aik wavelength ka izafi faasla (roshan) hai. Kitab aik 'Fig 15.21' ka hawala bhi deti hai jo maujood nahi.

Tajziye ko aasan banane ke liye farz karein ke slits se screen tak faasla L slit ke darmiyani faasle d ke muqable itna bara hai ke S1 aur S2 se nuqta P tak lakeerein taqreeban mutawazi hain. Roshni ke liye aam taur par aisa hi hota hai: slits ka faasla millimetre ke hisse se chand millimetre, jab ke screen aik metre ya zyada door hoti hai. Phir rasta farq r2 - r1 = d sin(theta) (15.1) hai, jahan theta slits se P tak lakeer aur slits ki satah ke normal ke darmiyan zawiya hai.
Do slits ka constructive aur destructive interference

Constructive interference (taqwiyat) wahan hota hai jahan rasta farq wavelengths ka poora adad ho, is liye roshan ilaqe un zawiyon theta par hote hain jin ke liye d sin(theta) = m lambda, m = 0, 1, 2, 3, ... (15.2). Destructive interference (khatma), jo andhere ilaqe banata, wahan hota hai jahan rasta farq wavelengths ka aadha-poora adad ho: d sin(theta) = (m + 1/2) lambda. Naqsha slits ke mutawazi roshan aur andhere patton ka silsila hai.

Fringes ki jagahein: farz karein ym pattern ke markaz (theta = 0) se m-wein roshan patti ke markaz tak faasla hai, aur theta_m mutalliqa zawiya. Phir ym = L tan(theta_m) (15.3). Aise tajurbat mein ym, L se bohat chhota hota hai, is liye theta_m bohat chhota aur sin(theta_m) taqreeban tan(theta_m) hai; yun ym = L sin(theta_m) (15.4). d sin(theta_m) = m lambda istemal karne par m-wein roshan patti ki jagah ym = m L lambda / d (15.5), aur pados ke roshan (ya andhere) fringes ke markazon ka faasla dy = L lambda / d (15.6) hai.

Fringes ka faasla slits ke faasle d ke ulat mutanasib hai: slits jitne qareeb, naqsha utna phailta hai. Yeh nataij har qism ki lehar par laagu hain, ba-shart ke do coherent sources ki nateeja lehar d ke muqable door kisi nuqte par pakri jaye.

blocks.alt: Oopar: baen rukawat par d faasle par slits S1 aur S2; daen L faasle par screen. Slits se screen par nuqta P tak do neeli lakeerein, markazi lakeer se y oonchai aur theta zawiye par. S2 ke qareeb chhota surkh hissa rasta farq d sin(theta) dikhata. Neeche: rasta farq = d sin(theta); roshan jahan d sin(theta) = m lambda, andhera jahan d sin(theta) = (m + 1/2) lambda; chhote zawiyon par ym = mL lambda / d aur fringe ka faasla dy = L lambda / d.
blocks.caption: Young ke double slit ki geometry (Figs 15.8 se 15.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Kyunke screen door hai, P tak dono shuaein taqreeban mutawazi hain aur S2 se izafi faasla d sin(theta) hai. Raaste ki har izafi wavelength hamein agle roshan fringe tak le jati hai.

blocks.text: 600 nm wavelength ki roshni 0.30 mm door do slits se guzarti hai, aur fringes 1.5 m door screen par dekhe jate hain. Fringe ka faasla dy = L lambda / d = (1.5 m)(600 x 10^-9 m) / (0.30 x 10^-3 m) = 3.0 x 10^-3 m = 3.0 mm.

blocks.prompt: Slits ke faasle d aur screen ke faasle L se y faasle ke fringes bante hain. Agar d aur L dono dugne kar diye jayein to fringes ka naya faasla kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: y: dy = L lambda / d, aur L aur d dono dugne karne se tanasub nahi badalta.

blocks.prompt: Agar Young ka poora saaman pani mein rakh diya jaye to fringes ka kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: Pani mein roshni ki wavelength kam hoti hai (lambda / n, n taqreeban 1.33), is liye fringe ka faasla L lambda / d ghatta hai: fringes qareeb aa jate hain.

items: Roshan: d sin(theta) = m lambda; andhera: (m + 1/2) lambda.
ym = mL lambda / d; faasla dy = L lambda / d (qareeb slits par zyada).
